scope: Frontend only. Accepted backend audit reused solely for ID/catalog metadata; no backend re-audit.

method.tree_counts: Git blob paths and sizes, pinned commits, no README counts. Asset files exclude thumbnails outside game roots; repeated codec/resolution variants count as files not games.
method.class_A: Static local entry+game JS+config references+atlas image gate on CreateJS/Pixi family; not a runtime certification or exhaustive semantic proof.
method.class_B: Mostly populated payload, explicit gaps or unresolved loader closure; provisional where closure is not established.
method.class_C: Asset/authoring-source evidence without a verified browser deliverable.
method.class_D: Substantial JS but no game asset set.
method.class_F: No frontend deliverable in scope; includes out-of-scope native/server projects, not necessarily fraudulent.
method.class_G: Security override, represented separately as security_risk HIGH; suspicious does not erase valid payload evidence.
method.normalized_family: One trailing GT/GTM/DX/CL/PT/PTM/AM/EGT/KA suffix removed; only a conservative deduplication aid, not verified commercial title identities.
method.limits: Static parse/reference gate does not prove feature correctness, backend compatibility, rights, offline boot, every language/browser/permutation, or clean security.
method.no_global_addition: Mirrors and duplicate Pragmatic captures are not summed into a unique complete catalog.
